evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage in src/node/blockstorage.cpp (+189/-26) and src/node/blockstorage.h.
rationale: The PR provides a clean, crash-safe way to reobfuscate or rotate XOR keys on existing block files without redownloading the entire chain. While solving a real administrative limitation for pre-v28 datadirs, obfuscation is intended to prevent false-positive antivirus triggers rather than enforce consensus or node safety, making review worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
